name: Chromolase
manufacturer: the Gray Zone lab synthesis — believed to have originated from a disgruntled Lazarus Pharmaceuticals biotech engineer
description: Chromolase is a targeted biological compound engineered to attack the SNT interface polymers that connect cybernetic augmentation systems to organic neural tissue, causing progressive and chaotic malfunction of all connected chrome. The compound degrades the organic-synthetic boundary layer, causing augments to misfire, receive garbled signals, operate with inverted or randomized controls, or in severe cases, lock into maximum-output states. Combat chrome becomes a liability; sensory augments produce overwhelming false input; strength augments may activate uncontrollably. The compound specifically targets augmented individuals — unaugmented subjects experience only mild nausea.
effects: Progressive malfunction of all SNT-connected cybernetic systems
Randomized or inverted control signals to augments
Sensory augments produce false, overwhelming, or inverted sensory data
Motor augments may lock, spasm, or activate uncontrollably
Combat augments become dangerous to the user — weapons may fire or retract randomly
side_effects: Physical injury from malfunctioning augments is the primary risk — rate of self-injury is high
SNT interface layer damage may require expensive medical repair post-exposure
In subjects with life-sustaining augments (cardiac assist, respiratory support), Chromolase can be directly fatal
Residual chrome instability can persist for days after the compound clears
duration: 30-60 minutes acute effect; residual instability for 24-72 hours
cultural_context: Chromolase is the Gray Zone's revenge fantasy made real — in a city where augmentation correlates directly with tier and power, a compound that turns chrome against its owner is profoundly political. the Gray Zone gangs use it to neutralize corpo security teams whose augmentation gives them overwhelming tactical advantage. There is a grim humor in its use: a heavily augmented enforcer who can bench-press a vehicle becomes helpless, flailing, potentially injuring himself with his own hardware. In higher tiers, Chromolase exposure is treated as a catastrophic attack — equivalent to a weapon of mass disruption — and its possession triggers immediate escalation from corporate security. The underground augment-repair economy has grown substantially in neighborhoods where it circulates.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 corporate security contractor with military-grade chrome wakes up from what she thinks was a blackout to find her arm augment has destroyed her apartment — she has no memory of it and her chrome logs show only corrupted data from a 40-minute window.

A the Gray Zone gang is offering Chromolase canisters to anyone willing to use them against a rival crew that has been recruiting heavily augmented muscle — but the compound is getting into the water supply of the surrounding block and people with medical augments are dying.

Someone has synthesized a variant of Chromolase that doesn't clear in 60 minutes — a permanent chrome degradation agent — and they're looking for a buyer with enough Phi to make the sale worth dying over.
